Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

program = '''from collections import Counter
from scipy import ndimage

def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    H,W=len(a),len(a[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in a for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mask=[[v!=bg for v in r] for r in a]
    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)
    objs=ndimage.find_objects(lab)
    singles=[]; blocks=[]
    for k,sl in enumerate(objs,1):
        if sl is None: continue
        ys,xs=sl; h=ys.stop-ys.start; w=xs.stop-xs.start
        val=a[ys.start][xs.start]
        if h==1 and w==1: singles.append((ys.start,xs.start,val))
        else: blocks.append((ys.start,xs.start,h,w,val))
    sy=sorted(set(y for y,x,v in singles))
    rows=[[v for y,x,v in sorted([p for p in singles if p[0]==yy],key=lambda p:p[1])] for yy in sy]
    by=min(y for y,x,h,w,v in blocks)
    seed=sorted([b for b in blocks if b[0]==by],key=lambda b:b[1])
    bh,bw=seed[0][2],seed[0][3]
    colors=[b[4] for b in seed]
    xstep=seed[1][1]-seed[0][1] if len(seed)>1 else bw+1
    found=None
    for ri,row in enumerate(rows):
        for start in range(len(row)-len(colors)+1):
            if row[start:start+len(colors)]==colors:
                found=(ri,start)
    if found is None: return a
    ri,start=found
    x0=seed[0][1]-start*xstep
    for i,row in enumerate(rows):
        y=by+(i-ri)*(bh+1)
        for j,color in enumerate(row):
            x=x0+j*xstep
            for yy in range(y,y+bh):
                for xx in range(x,x+bw):
                    if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W: a[yy][xx]=color
    return a
'''
(base/f'{tid}.py').write_text(program)
ns={}; exec(program,ns)
